notes: From client feedback: pickers can go back mid-run and fix an earlier line; totes are optional; product photos at every pick stop; Status and Customer filters on the pick queue; a "Can it ship?" flag on every order (Can ship, Partial, Printing, No stock); receiving shows where a SKU already lives and suggests spots beside the customer's stock; batch picks by zone (whole orders only), customer, rush or packing type; and a Fix button to change, remove or add items mid-pick, upgrade shipping, or allow a partial shipment for one order.
